posts.text:
Hell yeah


Senator Scott Wiener (@Scott_Wiener)

I passed California’s law authorizing “entertainment zones” — locally designated zones where bars & restaurants can sell alcohol onto the street. That was previously illegal under state law. San Francisco has established more than 30 entertainment zones under that law. They’re a huge success — making our streets more vibrant & helping small businesses thrive.







— https://nitter.net/Scott_Wiener/status/2073069988114796940#m
